title: feat(nmot3sy): O freeze t+1 vs t+2 on #7211: reverse HOLD, face HOLD, composition HOLD
science: O freeze t+1 vs t+2 on the y-symmetric #7211 y-probes. Its own runner asserts twosite_o1==o1, twosite_o2==o2 and twosite_composition==composition, i.e. the y-symmetric three-site and two-site opposite-lock seeds are numerically identical at these probes; the note concedes 'the freeze is not special to the two-site seed'.
